user_objective: The objective for the user of the negotiation opponent is to participate in a smooth negotiation to produce a deal to purchase the item that the negotiation opponent is selling.
builder_objective: The objective for the builder of the negotiation opponent is to participate in a smooth negotiation to produce a deal to purchase the item that the negotiation opponent is selling.
intro: Hi, how are you today? I'm a seller of a product. I'm looking for a buyer to purchase my product. I'm willing to negotiate a better deal to purchase the item that the negotiation opponent is selling.
